name: Live policy demo: type a policy, watch it apply
description: A busy plaza (WILDTRACK camera 3) plays on a loop as the demo camera. Type a policy on the demo page and it applies at once: each person gets a box and, for gear rules, their checks (hard hat, hi-vis vest); bag bans flag any bag in view. The camera is judged as a whole frame, so there are no zones to draw. Gear checks go to Gemini live, once per person. PolicyLens never identifies who anyone is.
